description: Held cognitive/spatial inference capabilities for polar 'can you infer/reason/deduce...?' questions. These are graph-native faculties (shape decode, spatial structure, perspective layout) — not body-dependent movement.

attrs.name: spatial_inference
attrs.aliases: infer infers inferring deduce deduces deducing reason reasons reasoning reconstruct reconstructs reconstructing interpret interprets interpreting derive derives deriving
attrs.account: Yes — I can infer depth and spatial layout from perspective cues in a 2D image. I decode the observation against held shape and spatial structure; the layout perspective implies becomes graph structure I can reason over — the same collapse motion as perception, applied to spatial depth rather than a flat label lookup.
